evidence.result: Small checkpoint via transformers depth-estimation pipeline on a generated 640x480 receding-floor scene: depth map 480x640 float32; near disc median 9.1815 vs far disc median 0.9429 (ordering correct); floor band 260/260 adjacent row pairs non-decreasing toward the bottom; fresh-process rerun byte-identical. CPU, macOS arm64.
evidence.scope: Small checkpoint via transformers pipeline on CPU; one generated receding-floor scene: near>far, floor 260/260 pairs monotone, rerun byte-identical; relative depth only; macOS arm64

summary: Monocular depth-estimation model with Python inference and downloaded checkpoints. It produces relative depth maps for still images; only the Small checkpoint is Apache-2.0, while larger checkpoints carry non-commercial terms.
use_when: Generate relative depth maps for 2.5D still-image moves
Use the Small checkpoint where commercial-use licensing is required
avoid_when: Use a maintained video-depth model for temporally consistent sequences
Avoid larger checkpoints for commercial work absent separate rights
